question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/603e6ce7c805bb3e168f6253ec8d73148149bb9ebe6304600ec207dcd6497cc0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes taking figure 1 and figure 2 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 1 is common on both figure 1 and figure 2, it is clear that 2, 4, 5 and 6 are adjacent to it and remaining number i.e., 3 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b79092c2f03b82e705143033379da2eda0139cdcc8ab1843512c537d4c12156.png] 

Opposite pairs:

4 → 2

5 → 6

1 → 3

So, the opposite side of "1" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "3".
